metadata.title: झाबुआ का जंगली कड़कनाथ मुर्गा और नीम की शराब | Kadaknath Murga Cooking in a Tribal village
metadata.description:
The black chicken, known as Kadaknath is a very famous dish from Jhabua district of Madhya Pradesh. Jhabua is a tribal dominated district and Bhil tribe is in majority here. It was a rare occasion when we got a chance to cook and eat Kadaknath with a bhil family. We also tasted the local whine, which was prepared using Neem.
